summary: Iteration 8: verified i18n (DE default + EN toggle) and host thumbnails across backend and frontend. Backend pytest: 33/33 pass, including new test_embed_smiooaxb_returns_thumbnail asserting GET /api/embed/SMioOAxb returns top-level thumbnail on doimg.net AND DoodStream host entry has thumbnail on doimg.net. Frontend: landing page defaults to DE with data-testid='language-toggle' showing 'DE'; German phrases (Anmelden, Loslegen, Browser-Tab-Player, Geo-Umsatz-Routing, Offline-Erkennung, Statistiken pro Film, Jetzt starten) render; clicking toggle switches to EN (Sign in, Get started, Browser-Tab Player, ...) and localStorage 'lang' persists across reload. Toggle present on /login, /dashboard, /admin and embed /e/SMioOAxb. Dashboard DE labels (Meine Mirrors, Admin-Bereich, Neuer Mirror, Abmelden, Aufrufe gesamt, Online-Links) and EN equivalents both render; nav-my-mirrors / nav-admin-panel testids stable. Admin tabs testids (admin-tab-overview/hosts/users/settings) stable across languages; DE (Übersicht, Anbieter & Sätze, Benutzer, Seiten-Einstellungen) and EN (Overview, Users, Site Settings) both render. New mirror form DE labels (Titel, Beschreibung, Anbieter-Embed-Links) render. Dashboard shows 2 doimg.net thumbnails (Perfect Match 1 + Sasha Unleashed). Embed player /e/SMioOAxb shows small doimg.net poster next to title, DE 'Bestbezahlter Anbieter zuerst' + 'Bereitgestellt von MirrorStream' visible; iframe referrerpolicy=no-referrer, no sandbox. Regressions all pass (geo ordering, canonical dsvplay.com DoodStream, rotating VOE direct domain, admin login, site settings).
critical_code_review_comments: I18nContext.jsx: t() falls back to translations.en[key] then key when missing, which is fine, but no logging on missing translation - adding a dev-mode console.warn would surface unlocalized strings early.
Language state lives only in React context; no <html lang> attribute is updated on toggle, hurting accessibility/SEO. Consider document.documentElement.lang = lang inside setLang.

Site-settings hero description + footer are intentionally English-only per problem statement, but admins have no per-language override; if multilanguage is a product commitment, hero_description/footer_text should also be i18n-aware (or seeded per-locale).

server.py get_embed selects top-level thumbnail = first host that has any thumbnail. Order is provider-config order (not per-viewer geo order), so display could differ from the resolved best-paying provider. Consider using enriched[0]['thumbnail'] after geo sort so poster matches the auto-selected tab.

resolve_mirror_links stores thumbnail only from DoodStream (splash_img); VOE api_resolve_link returns thumbnail=None. If VOE API exposes a poster (file/info includes single_img/splash_img), wire it up so VOE-only mirrors also get a poster on dashboard/embed.
